result.title: WeMM-Ecom: Advancing Multimodal Content Understanding for WeChat E-Commerce
result.summary: We present WeMM-Ecom, a family of multimodal large language models that deliver frontier e-commerce capabilities while achieving state-of-the-art general-purpose performance at their respective scales. The family spans five sizes, from a 0.8B dense model to a 35B mixture-of-experts model with 3B active parameters. Our training pipeline begins with two-stage continued pre-training that progressively raises the proportion of e-commerce data within a diverse multimodal data mixture, followed by hybrid-thinking post-training that combines on-policy distillation and reinforcement learning to support both non-thinking and thinking modes. For evaluation, we construct a comprehensive suite of 28 e-commerce benchmarks (23 in-house and five open-source) covering eight business scenarios and complement it with 64 public general-purpose benchmarks. On the e-commerce suite, WeMM-Ecom-35B-A3B surpasses substantially larger open-source flagship models, including Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, HY4, and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. On the general-purpose suite, every WeMM-Ecom model surpasses its similarly sized Qwen3.5 counterpart, with the lightweight variants (e.g., WeMM-Ecom-2B) showing clear advantages over leading lightweight models such as Qwen3.5-2B, MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B, and LFM3-VL-2B. Beyond benchmarks, WeMM-Ecom now powers hundreds of production use cases in WeChat, including catalog management, multimodal product search, and livestream commerce, serving billion-scale requests per day. We publicly release all model weights and detail our data curation, training recipe, and benchmark construction to facilitate future work on domain-specialized multimodal models. We have released the model weights and code to facilitate future research at https://github.com/Tencent/WeMM-Ecom.

AI.brief_summary: WeMM-Ecom 是面向微信电商的多模态大模型系列（0.8B 稠密到 35B-A3B MoE），经两阶段继续预训练与 hybrid-thinking 后训练（on-policy distillation 结合 RL）同时支持思考与非思考模式，并构建 28 个电商基准评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 整体属领域 VLM 能力刷分与落地报告，未涉及 latent 状态或视觉证据筛选；仅其统一思考/非思考模式的后训练配方可供核查是否含模式切换、推理长度与监督分配细节，可能为 THINK/STOP 训练提供线索。
